findings.issue: Spec §5 declares `requiredCountsRiverBet: boolean` and `valueThresholdPct: 50 | 65` as required fields on PostflopRecommendation; the build made both optional.
findings.evidence: `readonly requiredCountsRiverBet?: boolean;` and `readonly valueThresholdPct?: 50 | 65;` with comments citing hand-built inputs in locked tests. recommendPostflop always sets both, and grade.ts/explain.ts handle absence, so behaviour is correct.
findings.fix: Accept and record the deviation in the build notes (it avoids editing more locked hand-built fixtures), or make them required and update the hand-built literals.

findings.issue: The AC#6 in-process sit-and-go run changes its input seed 42 -> 7 rather than re-pinning a value; this goes beyond a one-for-one value replacement.
findings.evidence: `collect(10_000, 7, 6, 'sng', ...)`; comment says seed 42's first SNG no longer ends inside 10,000 hands. Check count is unchanged (69/69) and the restart behaviour is still exercised.
findings.fix: Keep it (the stated behaviour needs an SNG that ends inside the run) but list it explicitly in the build notes as an input change, not a value re-pin, for the TASK-1.16 owner.

findings.fix: Rename to 'AC#6 65.1% against callers raises (50.1% before TASK-7.32)' if renaming a locked test title is allowed; otherwise leave the comment.

findings.issue: The Q-3 clause is injected by `String.replace(POT_ODDS_LEAD, ...)`; if a template's pot-odds wording ever drifts from the constant, the replace silently does nothing and the river bet goes unmentioned. Only pot-odds-fold is tested.
findings.evidence: All five owed-chips templates currently contain 'Pot odds, {def:pot-odds}, ask', so behaviour is correct today.
findings.fix: Optionally add a unit assertion that every PostflopTemplateKey except value-bet/check-free contains POT_ODDS_LEAD.

summary: The change does what the spec asks, and every SPEC item has a test that would catch a broken implementation. The turn price is (call+R)/(pot+call+2R), with R = min(bigBet, stack after call) on the turn when at least one opponent can still bet, and 0 otherwise. The 65% threshold applies only when a bet is owed. Grading measures from valueThresholdPct ?? 50. All 16 locked/re-baselined files keep their assertion counts, and the edits replace pinned values; the one exception is an input change (games SNG seed 42 -> 7). Untouched: style-bands and check-styles. The 13 golden replacements keep seats, street and action; the histogram is identical. All are logged with reasons, along with the graded-example margin change 26.9 -> 18.3. The REQ-033.1 and REQ-033.2 amendments match the code. golden.ts and explanations.md are justified consequences of A-3 and Q-3. Reviewer runs: the targeted tests pass, and the 100k slow check passes at 22.2/16.2/64.3/40.4/51.5. No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings. Side note: TASK-7.25 (switch bots to action ranges) now looks superseded by this story.
